decisions.context: Initial website implementation for a local association.
decisions.chosen: static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript
decisions.reason: W0 content site; no backend or dynamic data required; zero paid dependencies and minimal attack surface.
decisions.tradeoffs: Manual source editing instead of CMS authoring workflow.
decisions.evidence: No package dependencies; local static preview.

decisions.context: Unverified current venue and conflicting historical address.
decisions.chosen: omit street address; ask visitors to contact association
decisions.reason: Sources disagree; latest reported suffix conflicts with older municipal/press sources.

decisions.context: Opening times in older sources only.
decisions.risk: HIGH if outdated details misdirect visitors.

decisions.chosen: email-first CTA; no form or diagnosis question
decisions.reason: No business need to collect sensitive personal data online in v1.

options: provisional typographic identity and CSS art
decisions.chosen: provisional wordmark and abstract CSS illustration
decisions.reason: Creates coherent presentation without claiming official logo status.

decisions.context: The document-level Escape handler previously always closed the menu and focused its toggle, even when the menu was already closed.
options: Always focus the trigger on Escape
Ignore Escape when the menu is closed; restore focus only when dismissing an open menu
decisions.chosen: Ignore Escape unless aria-expanded is true; restore focus only after closing an open menu.
decisions.reason: Avoids unexpected focus movement to a hidden trigger on desktop and while the mobile menu is already closed.
decisions.tradeoffs: The key handler is state-aware and has a dedicated dependency-free regression test.
decisions.evidence: node tests/test_menu.js passes against the actual script.js.

decisions.context: CR-001 expands informational requirements and photo/motion direction.
options: Adopt evidence-derived contract 0.2 in authorized Loop 003
decisions.chosen: Adopt Product Contract 0.2 as active evidence-derived baseline, not human-approved.
decisions.reason: The exact CONTINUE authorized Loop 003 following CR-001; requirements are traceable and use conservative factual framing.
decisions.reversibility: Versioned contract and Git history preserve 0.1.

decisions.context: The request calls for more imagery but real participant photos are not cleared.
options: Use local original non-identifying SVG illustrations pending permission
decisions.chosen: Use original local SVG illustrations clearly labelled as illustrations.
decisions.reason: Public visibility is not publication permission, especially for minors and vulnerable people.
decisions.reversibility: Replace with approved documentary imagery after rights/consent clearance.

decisions.context: Scroll animations may affect accessibility or essential content visibility.
options: Use progressive IntersectionObserver enhancement with reduced-motion/unsupported fallback
decisions.chosen: Progressive reveal; only apply hidden initial state when observer is supported and reduced motion is off.
decisions.reason: Content remains visible without JavaScript/observer and respects reduced-motion preferences.
decisions.reversibility: Remove enhancement without altering content structure.

decisions.context: User requested shorter sections, less generic typography, a professional design and a stronger visual background.
options: Retain the image-heavy pastel cards and long story mosaic
Consolidate duplicate content into a concise editorial five-section page with a restrained palette and typographic hierarchy
decisions.chosen: Consolidate into five sections: hero, activities, welcome/first contact, APAiL, contact.
decisions.reason: The previous design repeated welcome/approach/first-step/volunteer content and relied heavily on generic repeated illustration cards. A concise editorial layout better communicates the documented welcome/listening ethos with less scrolling.
decisions.tradeoffs: Dated social-post mosaic and decorative placeholder illustrations are removed; fewer visual story details are displayed.
decisions.evidence: Loop 006 structural validator, Chromium viewport sweep and screenshots.

decisions.context: The user supplied the exact Bulle Bleue - APAiL Facebook page as a potential official brand source.
options: Use a different-ID third-party mirror as if it were the supplied page
Link the exact user-supplied page, but defer logo/photo reuse until that exact page's assets can be verified
decisions.chosen: Add the exact Facebook URL in contact and footer; do not copy an unverified logo or photographs.
decisions.reason: The supplied page URL was blocked by the fetch environment. A public mirror surfaced a different page ID (100620708811103 versus the supplied 100066715807933), so identity cannot be assumed.
decisions.tradeoffs: The current BB monogram and palette remain provisional; official artwork is still unverified.
decisions.evidence: Direct attempt to open user-provided Facebook URL; FindGlocal mirror ID comparison.

decisions.context: A distinctive display/body type system should remain free of paid services and avoid unnecessary third-party requests.
options: Use an editorial font stack with platform fallback and no remote font request
decisions.chosen: Use EB Garamond/Cabin when available, with Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Georgia, Avenir Next, Segoe UI and other local system fallbacks.
decisions.reason: No paid service or remote font request is required; the Chromium environment confirmed both named faces are locally available.
decisions.tradeoffs: Rendering may fall back to a platform font on visitor devices where EB Garamond or Cabin is not installed; cross-platform fallback inspection remains outstanding.
decisions.evidence: Chromium 144 document.fonts checks and CSS source inspection.
